description: This Java class 'FilePathUtils' provides utility methods for constructing various URL and file path strings used throughout the shopping application, including static resource paths, download URLs, store URIs, and admin URLs.

classes.name: FilePathUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for building URLs and file paths related to store resources, downloads, and store-specific links.

methods.name: buildStaticFilePath
methods.description: Constructs a file path for static content like images based on store code and image name.

methods.name: buildAdminDownloadProductFilePath
methods.description: Builds a URL for downloading digital product files in an admin context.

methods.name: buildOrderDownloadProductFilePath
methods.description: Constructs a download URL for a specific order's digital product.

methods.name: buildStoreUri
methods.description: Constructs the base URI for a store, given its store object and HTTP request.

methods.name: buildStoreUri
methods.description: Constructs the store URI based on store object and a context path string.

methods.name: buildCustomerUri
methods.description: Builds the URL to the customer dashboard section for a store, given store object and context path.

methods.name: buildAdminUri
methods.description: Builds the admin section URL for a store, based on store object and HTTP request.

methods.name: buildCategoryUrl
methods.description: Constructs a URL for a specific category within the store.

methods.name: buildProductUrl
methods.description: Constructs a URL for a specific product within the store.
